mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and PAYEMS increase for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal expanding residential construction and broader economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST increases for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105) define a recession regime where supply chain disruptions depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with two consecutive INDPRO declines below 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.
